desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on apparent strikes and explosions near Iran’s Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, alongside a Russian hospital attack in Kherson and Saudi defensive diplomacy. The single most important development is the cluster of reports around Qeshm, with unclear attribution but indications of incoming or outgoing strikes.

## MAIN THREADS

### Qeshm Island explosions and possible strikes
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117369308963557608) reported an explosion SW of Qeshm Island in Hormozgan Province, Iran, citing a delayed FromIran feed.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2117365811463819424) noted early local reports of explosions near Qeshm Island following claims the IRGC downed two U.S. MQM-170 drones in the area; unclear if strikes were outgoing or incoming.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117371645560070461) tracked a Qatari VIP aircraft (A7-AAG) outbound from Tehran, linking it to the regional activity.

### Russian strike on Kherson hospital
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2117371065899057242) reported that Russian forces attacked a hospital in Kherson on the first day after the ceasefire ended, posting video evidence.

### Saudi defensive coordination
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2117371000769663258) detailed calls by Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman with French, U.S., and Greek counterparts amid ongoing operations against Houthi threats.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117367442578313391) stated there were no blasts in Tehran, only thunder (unconfirmed).
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117370272009355557) assessed the Qatari flight was too far from the Strait of Hormuz (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are monitoring further clarification on the Qeshm incidents, possible escalation in the Strait of Hormuz, and any follow-on Saudi or Iranian statements. Kherson developments may test the recent ceasefire.
